attributes.name: Frost Lance +2
attributes.powers: For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 2d8 and the Cold trait. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. On this check, you may reveal a card that has the Mount trait to ignore the 2-Handed trait on this card.; if you do and this is your first combat check of the turn, add another 1d8+2. If you would fail this check, you may recharge this card to reroll the dice; take the new result.
